assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: native transparent animation-parts atlas for Mina in the Horizons study app. Reference image: the THREE-COLUMN character sheet provided. Rebuild ONLY MINA, the first-column young adult woman with warm medium skin, dark wavy bob, magenta open jacket, cream T-shirt, navy trousers, orange trainers and orange backpack. Preserve her identity, adult proportions and clean friendly flat illustration style; no outlines, gradients only very subtle.
Create a STRICT 4-column by 4-row grid, all 16 cells equal size, with abundant transparent gutters. EACH CELL CONTAINS ONLY ONE DETACHED PART, no text labels or grid lines. Every part completely visible, no clipping. Straight neutral orientation, frontal/slight three-quarter face as reference. Parts need round overlapping ends for joints. No full person anywhere.
Row 1 cells left to right: (1) complete jacket-and-shirt TORSO from neck through hips, no head/arms/legs; (2) HEAD including intact dark hair and neck, eyebrows and nose, but NO EYES and NO MOUTH; (3) viewer-left UPPER ARM magenta jacket sleeve shoulder to elbow, downwards; (4) viewer-left FOREARM including wrist and friendly open hand, elbow at TOP, fingers at BOTTOM, downwards.
Row 2: (1) viewer-right UPPER ARM magenta sleeve shoulder to elbow downward; (2) viewer-right FOREARM with open hand, elbow at TOP and fingers BOTTOM; (3) viewer-left navy trouser LEG including orange shoe, hip at TOP and shoe at BOTTOM; (4) viewer-right navy trouser LEG including orange shoe, same.
Row 3: (1) two OPEN expressive dark eyes as one isolated overlay, no surrounding face; (2) two CLOSED eyes as one matching isolated overlay, same eye spacing, no surrounding face; (3) smiling mouth isolated; (4) small speaking open mouth isolated.
Row 4: (1) orange backpack alone, front/threequarter enough to place behind torso; (2) small folded-open pale map with simple colored route markings, NO TEXT; (3) isolated friendly pointing hand of matching skin; (4) isolated thumbs-up hand of matching skin.
All parts same character scale and style, drawing shapes large within their equal cells but separated and never crossing cell boundaries. Real transparent alpha background. No shadows outside parts. No labels, frames, border, watermark.
